limitations: Temporary path lengths and generated identities affect exact payload bytes.
Commands, reads, dispatches, returns and recovery calls all count; these are not provider model turns.
The reference is disciplined v1 and is not inflated with redundant introspection.
Additional v2 metadata/return retention and log recovery can increase transport.
Historical published measurements and frozen studies remain unchanged.
reference_contract: Both arms use managed prepare/finish and the same worker-facing launch/return contract. v1 has no redundant role/skill introspection; v2 requests generated dispatch and retains structured returns.
scope: One deterministic local fake-host lifecycle with actual Kitsu commands; no model execution, provider tokens, coordinator model-turn count, quality-equivalence or savings claim.

serialization.canonical_cli: program + space + words separated by space + newline + exact stdin
serialization.fake_native: exact serialized JSON envelopes recorded by the scripted adapter
